title: WATCH: Brazil's Lula lands in Manila for talks with Marcos, ASEAN Summit
summary: The visit is expected to further strengthen ties between the Philippines and Brazil, including cooperation on issues of mutual interest.

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has arrived in the Philippines for a state visit and the 49th ASEAN Summit.
He is scheduled to meet President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and attend the summit as a Guest of the Chair.
The visit marks the first time a sitting Brazilian president has made a state visit to the Philippines. — Martin Ramos
